items.description: An ancient people of the Middle East known for courage, hospitality, and cultural richness.

journey.title: The Journey
journey.subtitle: Explore the key milestones that shaped the Kurdistan Region from 1991 until today.

items.description: A historic turning point that opened the path to a new reality.
The first parliament and government marked the beginning of self-rule.

items.title: Building Institutions
items.description: Public institutions gradually formed the structure of modern governance.
Federal recognition gave constitutional status to the Kurdistan Region.

items.title: Today
items.description: Kurdistan continues to grow through institutions, development, and vision.

1991.headline: A historic turning point.
1991.description: A moment of courage and unity that opened the path to a new chapter for the Kurdistan Region.

cards.title: Historic Uprising
cards.description: In 1991, a major uprising marked a turning point in Kurdish history in Iraq.

cards.title: A New Reality
cards.description: This moment opened the way for a new political and administrative reality in the Kurdistan Region.

cards.title: A Foundation for the Future
cards.description: The developments of 1991 laid the groundwork for modern self-governance.

1992.headline: The beginning of self-rule.
1992.description: A pivotal year when the Kurdistan Region took a decisive step toward building its own institutions and shaping its future.

cards.title: First Election
cards.description: In 1992, the Kurdistan Region held its first parliamentary election.

cards.title: Parliament and Government
cards.description: The first parliament and government were formed, marking the beginning of modern self-rule.

cards.title: A Defining Milestone
cards.description: This step transformed earlier achievements into an organized political reality.

institutions.title: Building Institutions
institutions.headline: From transition to governance.
institutions.description: Discover how institutions were established and strengthened to serve the people of Kurdistan.

cards.title: Public Institutions
cards.description: Over time, Kurdistan developed institutions that helped organize governance and public life.

cards.title: Parliament, Government, Presidency
cards.description: These institutions became essential parts of the regional political system.

cards.title: Institutional Growth
cards.description: Together, they helped shape a more structured and functioning regional administration.

cards.title: Constitutional Recognition
cards.description: In 2005, Iraq's constitution officially recognized the Kurdistan Region as a federal region.

cards.title: Legal Status
cards.description: This recognition affirmed the legal and constitutional status of the Region and its institutions.

cards.title: A New Chapter
cards.description: It marked an important step in the development of the Kurdistan Region within federal Iraq.

today.title: Today
today.headline: Growth, development, and vision.
today.description: Kurdistan is building a stronger tomorrow through progress, unity, and opportunity.

cards.title: Development
cards.description: Today, the Kurdistan Region continues to advance in infrastructure, education, and public services.

cards.title: Economy and Investment
cards.description: Economic growth, business activity, and investment remain important parts of the Region's future.

cards.title: Youth and Opportunity
cards.description: A new generation is helping shape Kurdistan through learning, work, and innovation.

cards.title: Looking Ahead
cards.description: Kurdistan continues to look forward with resilience, ambition, and confidence.

system.subtitle: Learn how the Kurdistan Region is governed through its key institutions and leadership roles.

items.title: 1. Parliament
items.description: The legislative institution responsible for laws and representation.

items.title: 2. Government
items.description: The executive body responsible for administration and public services.

items.title: 3. Presidency
items.description: A constitutional and national institution within the regional system.

items.title: 4. How It Works
items.description: Institutions work together through a parliamentary system.

items.title: 5. Leadership
items.description: Presidents, Prime Ministers, and Speakers helped shape the Region's development.

landFuture.subtitle: Explore Kurdistan's geography, symbols, protection, development, and future vision.

items.title: The Land
items.description: Erbil, Sulaymaniyah, Duhok, and Halabja form a region of beauty and heritage.

items.title: Identity and Symbols
items.description: The flag, anthem, language, and heritage reflect the spirit of Kurdistan.

items.title: Peshmerga
items.description: A symbol of courage, protection, and service.

items.title: Progress
items.description: Development continues in infrastructure, education, economy, and tourism.

items.title: Future Vision
items.description: Kurdistan looks ahead with ambition, opportunity, and confidence.

landing.subtitle: Kurdistan: The Cradle of Coexistence
landing.description: Across faiths, languages, and cultures, Kurdistan stands as a timeless home of respect, unity, and shared heritage.

cards.title: Religions
cards.text: Explore the rich religious heritage and sacred traditions of Kurdistan.

cards.title: Nationalities
cards.text: Discover the diverse ethnic communities, their languages, and cultural contributions.

cards.title: Stories of Coexistence
cards.text: Real stories of unity, protection, and everyday coexistence across Kurdistan.

sharedCelebrations.text: Festivals and holidays we celebrate together.

title: Religions
of Kurdistan
religionsKurdistan.subtitle: Eight recognized faiths, one shared homeland.

cards.title: Sunni Islam
cards.text: The largest faith tradition, rooted in Sunni Islam and Islamic scholarship.

cards.title: Christianity
cards.text: Ancient Christian communities with deep historical roots across Kurdistan.

cards.title: Yazidism
cards.text: A distinct spiritual tradition centered on reverence, ethics, and devotion.

cards.title: Yarsanism (Kaka'i)
cards.text: A mystical and humanistic path emphasizing truth, righteousness, and inner wisdom.

cards.title: Zoroastrianism
cards.text: An ancient faith of light and truth with a rich philosophical heritage.

cards.title: Judaism
cards.text: A historic community with enduring contributions to Kurdish life.

cards.title: Baha'i Faith
cards.text: A global faith that teaches unity, justice, and the oneness of humanity.

cards.title: Sabean-Mandaeanism
cards.text: An ancient baptismal tradition centered on spiritual purity and renewal.

footer.title: One Land, Many Paths
footer.text: Diverse in belief, united in coexistence.

title: Nationalities &
Communities
nationalities.subtitle: Languages, Heritage, and Belonging.
nationalities.description: Kurdistan is a home to many peoples. Each community brings its own history, language, and traditions-weaving together in a shared identity.

communities.title: Kurds
communities.text: The indigenous people of Kurdistan with a rich cultural heritage, language, and enduring spirit.

communities.title: Turkmens
communities.text: Descendants of Oghuz Turkic tribes, known for their hospitality, traditions, and vibrant culture.

communities.title: Assyrians
communities.text: An ancient Christian community with a deep historical presence and a strong cultural legacy.

communities.title: Chaldeans
communities.text: A distinct Christian community preserving the Chaldean rite, faith, and centuries-old traditions.

communities.title: Syriacs
communities.text: Keepers of one of the world's oldest liturgical traditions and a proud heritage of faith and learning.

communities.title: Armenians
communities.text: An ancient community with a rich cultural, religious, and artistic heritage in Kurdistan.

communities.title: Yazidis
communities.text: A spiritual community with unique beliefs, honoring peace, tolerance, and the cycles of nature.

title: Languages
of Kurdistan
languagesOfKurdistan.subtitle: Voices, Scripts, and Living Identity
languagesOfKurdistan.description: Across mountains and plains, many communities preserve their identities, pass down their stories, and build their futures-through language.

languages.title: Kurdish
languages.text: The heart of Kurdistan. Spoken in many dialects and written in Arabic, Latin, and Cyrillic scripts.

languages.title: Arabic
languages.text: A shared language across the region with deep roots in literature, faith, and daily life.

languages.title: Turkmen
languages.text: A Turkic language spoken by Turkmen communities, carrying oral traditions and poetry.

languages.title: Syriac
languages.text: An ancient Aramaic heritage language of Christian communities, kept alive in worship and tradition.

languages.title: Armenian
languages.text: A classical language with a rich literary and cultural legacy in Kurdistan's historic towns.

heritageCard.title: Language as Heritage
heritageCard.text: Languages carry our memories, our values, and our worldview. Preserving them means preserving who we are-for today and for generations to come.

footer.title: Many Tongues, One Homeland.
footer.text: Different languages. Shared stories. One Kurdistan.

quote.text: In this land, we have learned that our differences do not divide us - they strengthen us.
quote.author: Elder from Kurdistan

storyCards.title: A Safe Haven
storyCards.text: Generations have found protection and refuge in the mountains and cities of Kurdistan.

storyCards.title: Shared Celebrations
storyCards.text: From religious feasts to national holidays, communities come together in joy and solidarity.

storyCards.title: Living Side by Side
storyCards.text: Neighbors, colleagues, and friends - different in belief, united in daily life and mutual respect.

storyCards.title: Hospitality With Heart
storyCards.text: A tradition of welcoming others with open doors, food, and compassion.

items.text: Communities live and trade together across the region.
Faiths and cultures stand together in challenging times.
Acts of protection and shelter define Kurdistan's spirit.
Coexistence continues as a living heritage for the future.

footer.title: Together, We Build Tomorrow
footer.text: Diversity is our strength. Coexistence is our legacy.

title: Timeline of
Coexistence
timelineOfCoexistence.subtitle: A journey through memory, resilience, and shared life.

timeline.title: Roots of Diversity
timeline.text: Ancient peoples, languages, and faiths have shaped Kurdistan's rich and diverse heritage.

timeline.title: A Long-Standing Legacy
timeline.text: Communities of different religions and ethnicities lived, worked, and celebrated side by side.

timeline.title: Refuge and Resilience
timeline.text: In times of hardship, Kurdistan became a refuge-offering shelter, solidarity, and hope to many.

timeline.title: Recognition and Rights
timeline.text: The Kurdistan Region formally recognized multiple religions and communities in law.

timeline.title: Return and Continuity
timeline.text: Displaced families return home. Communities rebuild, traditions flourish, and bonds endure.

timeline.title: Shared Future
timeline.text: Together, we build a future grounded in respect, equality, and shared purpose.

items.title: Solidarity
items.text: Standing together in times of need and joy.

items.title: Peace
items.text: Choosing dialogue and understanding over division.

items.title: Heritage
items.text: Preserving our cultural and spiritual legacy.

items.title: Hope
items.text: Inspiring future generations to live together.

title: Shared
Celebrations
sharedCelebrations.subtitle: Festivals, Holidays, and Moments of Joy.

celebrations.title: Newroz
celebrations.text: The Kurdish New Year and a celebration of renewal, hope, and nature.

celebrations.title: Eid Al-Fitr
celebrations.text: Marking the end of Ramadan with gratitude, compassion, and togetherness.

celebrations.title: Eid Al-Adha
celebrations.text: A time of devotion, sacrifice, and care for families and neighbors.

celebrations.title: Christmas
celebrations.text: A celebration of faith, love, and the spirit of giving and peace.

celebrations.title: Easter
celebrations.text: A season of hope, renewal, and the promise of new beginnings.

celebrations.title: Yazidi Jemai Festival
celebrations.text: A sacred gathering of faith, remembrance, and unity in the Lalish Valley.

togetherCard.title: Together in Celebration
togetherCard.paragraph1: Across Kurdistan, diverse communities celebrate different occasions-each with its own beauty, stories, and meaning.
togetherCard.paragraph2: Yet in every celebration, we share what matters most: joy, hospitality, and belonging.

christianity.title: Christianity
christianity.subtitle: Ancient Roots, Living Communities.
christianity.description: Christianity has thrived in Kurdistan for nearly two millennia, shaping our heritage, culture, and values. Today, vibrant communities continue to build bridges of faith and harmony.

cards.title: Ankawa
cards.text: One of the world's oldest Christian communities, the Assyrian Church of the East has its spiritual heart in Ankawa.

cards.title: Churches
cards.text: From ancient monasteries to modern parishes, churches across Kurdistan stand as beacons of prayer and community.

cards.title: Major Denominations
cards.text: Christian life in Kurdistan is enriched by diverse traditions including the Assyrian Church of the East, Chaldean Catholic, Syriac Orthodox, and more.

cards.title: Sacred Sites
cards.text: Historic monasteries, shrines, and holy landscapes reflect a timeless legacy of devotion and resilience.

popeVisit.title: Pope Francis in Erbil
popeVisit.text: A historic visit of peace and hope. Pope Francis prayed for the people of Iraq and encouraged dialogue, reconciliation, and the protection of religious communities.

footer.title: Faith, hope, and love unite us across generations.
footer.text: Together, we build a future of dignity and peace.

yazidism.title: Yazidism
yazidism.subtitle: Sacred memory, resilience, and spiritual continuity.
yazidism.description: Rooted in ancient wisdom and nurtured through generations, Yazidism is a faith of light, truth, and compassion. It honors creation, cherishes freedom, and upholds the dignity of every soul.

cards.title: Lalish
cards.text: The holiest of Yazidism, nestled in the sacred valley of Lalish. A place of pilgrimage, learning, and spiritual renewal for thousands of Yazidis from around the world.

cards.title: Tawus Melek
cards.text: The Peacock Angel is the central figure in Yazidi belief. A symbol of divine wisdom, beauty, and the eternal presence of God's light in the world.

cards.title: Major Festivals
cards.text:
Carsema Sor - Red Wednesday
Ezidi New Year - Sere Sale
Cejna Ezi - The Festival of Gathering and Gratitude

cards.title: Remembrance of the 2014 Genocide
cards.text: We honor the memory of our martyrs and all victims of the 2014 genocide. We remember. We heal. We rise. We are Yazidi.

footer.title: Faith. Memory. Future.
footer.text: Through every trial, Yazidism endures. Our faith is our strength. Our memory is our promise. Our future is our light.

title: Other Faith
Traditions
otherFaithTraditions.subtitle: Yarsanism, Zoroastrianism, Judaism, Baha'i Faith, and Sabean-Mandaeanism
otherFaithTraditions.description: Kurdistan is a land of spiritual depth and cultural harmony, where diverse faiths have lived, prayed, and contributed to a shared legacy of peace and respect.

faiths.title: Yarsanism
faiths.text: An ancient Kurdish faith rooted in spiritual enlightenment and devotion to the Divine. Yarsanis value inner purity, truth, and respect for all living beings.
faiths.label: Kakai Shrines - Hawar Village

faiths.title: Zoroastrianism
faiths.text: One of the world's oldest monotheistic faiths, brought to the region through ancient migrations. It teaches the eternal struggle between good and evil and the pursuit of truth and virtue.
faiths.label: Zoroastrian Temple - Darbandikhan

faiths.title: Judaism
faiths.text: An ancient presence in Kurdistan, dating back thousands of years. Kurdish Jews have played a vital role in the cultural, economic, and social life of the region.
faiths.label: Shrine of the Prophet Nahum - Aqosh

faiths.title: Baha'i Faith
faiths.text: A modern faith that teaches the unity of God, the oneness of humanity, and the harmony of religion, science, and reason. Its message resonates deeply in a diverse world.

faiths.title: Sabean-Mandaeanism
faiths.text: An ancient Gnostic faith centered around John the Baptist as a prophet. It honors baptism, purity, and the light of knowledge.

diversityMap.description: Across mountains and valleys, different faiths, languages, and communities have woven a rich tapestry of life together-today and for generations.

places.text: A mosaic of cultures in the north.

places.title: Alqosh
places.text: One of the world's oldest Christian communities.

places.title: Erbil
places.text: A modern city with ancient roots.

places.title: Ankawa
places.text: A diverse neighborhood where communities thrive.

places.title: Lalish
places.text: Sacred to the Yazidi community for centuries.

places.title: Sulaymaniyah
places.text: A cultural and intellectual heart of Kurdistan.

places.title: Halabja
places.text: A symbol of resilience, peace, and coexistence.

infoCards.title: 8 Recognized Religions
infoCards.text: Islam, Christianity, Yazidism, Judaism, Sabean-Mandaeism, Zoroastrianism, Hinduism, and the Baha'i Faith.

infoCards.title: Shared Heritage
infoCards.text: Centuries of living together-building communities, traditions, and a shared identity that unites.

infoCards.title: Protected by Law
infoCards.text: Religious freedom and diversity are guaranteed by the Constitution of the Kurdistan Region.

footer.title: Every place has a story.
footer.text: Explore, learn, and celebrate the beautiful diversity of Kurdistan.

title: One Shared
Homeland
oneSharedHomeland.subtitle: Diversity, dignity, and a future together.
oneSharedHomeland.description: Kurdistan is not defined by one faith, one language, or one story. It is strengthened by all of them. Our diversity is our heritage. Our unity is our future.

values.title: Respect
values.text: We honor every belief, every identity, and every voice.

values.title: Protection
values.text: We stand together to protect rights, preserve heritage, and uphold human dignity.

values.title: Belonging
values.text: Everyone has a place here. Everyone belongs. This is our shared home.

values.title: Hope
values.text: We build a future of peace, opportunity, and possibilities for generations to come.

closing.title: Different faiths. Different languages. One shared homeland.

farewell.title: Thank You For Your Visit
farewell.text: Leave with understanding. Return with pride.
